Subject: Q1 pipeline sprint: leadership readout & account briefs

Team —

We need a tight pass on our Q1 pipeline ahead of the leadership readout on Thursday. I attached the consolidated workbook (Account_Snapshots_Q1_2027.xlsx) and a one-page runway summary (Pipeline_Runway_Summary.pdf). Please do the following by EOD Tuesday (Mar 1):

- Update your account row in the workbook with the most recent close date, updated ARR, next decision-maker interaction, and a one-line risk note (technical / procurement / exec sponsor).
- Flag any deals you want me to call out explicitly in the leadership slide (use the "Callout" column).
- If procurement requires a formal MOP or SOW, attach the latest doc to the account folder; I included a draft for Stratos (Stratos_Retail_MOP_v2.docx).

Quick notes: Stratos (Marissa) — I want your confident forecast number for week-of 3/7, and a short note on procurement timing (are they in legal review or vendor evaluation?).

I'll collect and synthesize first thing Wednesday and share a one-page summary for pre-read. Keep entries factual and conservative — leadership will want clear risks and mitigation asks.

Thanks —
Aditya

Hi Marissa / Aditya —

Thanks for the update and for the draft MOP you shared. A couple of clarifying points from procurement and legal:

- Procurement timeline: our SOW review is currently in legal. We expect comments back by 3/10. Procurement has said the business is pushing for a go-live in late March but legal review could push to early April if there are SOC2 items to resolve.
- SOC2: we need a statement of our current SOC2 status and any compensating controls for logs/data retention. If you can provide the attestation or a roadmap by EOD 3/4 that would accelerate things.
- Pricing: we are evaluating a 6-month pilot for a narrow SKU set. We anticipate a scaled contract if pilot is successful.

I can join a short alignment call tomorrow if that helps (we can do 9–10 PT). CC'd procurement.

Best,
Sarah Lim

sarah.lim@stratosretail.com
